title: Machine Learning & AI Research Intern
company_overview: Our Applied AI team invents and scales state-of-the-art foundation models and intelligent agent systems for enterprise knowledge workers.
responsibilities: Design, train, and evaluate deep learning architectures and LLM prompt/fine-tuning pipelines.
Benchmark retrieval algorithms and vector indexing techniques on large multi-modal datasets.
Implement data processing scripts, ablation studies, and qualitative evaluation suites in PyTorch.
Collaborate with research scientists to publish findings and integrate prototypes into product pipelines.
required_skills: Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML libraries (PyTorch, NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn).
Solid theoretical foundation in neural networks, gradient optimization, transformers, and evaluation metrics.
Experience preprocessing unstructured text or vision datasets and preventing data leakage.
Ability to read and reproduce research papers independently.
preferred_skills: Experience with Hugging Face Transformers, LoRA, and LLM fine-tuning.
Familiarity with Vector Databases (Chroma, FAISS, Pinecone) and RAG architectures.
Exposure to model quantization, ONNX/TensorRT optimization, or Docker containerization.
cultural_competencies: Scientific integrity and rigorous experimental benchmarking.
Persistence when diagnosing model training anomalies and divergence.
Clear communication of complex mathematical and algorithmic ideas.
